content:
FINAL GOAL EXECUTION — BUILD ONE REAL IVX SENIOR DEVELOPER WORKER

Stop producing certification reports.

The current IVX chat is a command interface, not an autonomous senior developer. Complete the missing system.

REQUIRED FLOW

IVX OWNER CHAT
→ DURABLE TASK CREATION
→ IVX SENIOR DEVELOPER WORKER
→ OWNER GITHUB
→ TESTS
→ OWNER APPROVAL
→ RENDER DEPLOYMENT
→ LIVE VERIFICATION
→ PROOF RETURNED TO THE SAME CHAT

PHASE 1 — FIX CHAT TRANSPORT

Fix permanently:

- 503 responses
- “Message is required”
- messages not reaching task creation
- missing taskId
- duplicate tasks
- contradictory task states
- lost tasks after restart

Every executable message must return HTTP 202 with:

- taskId
- status
- task type
- assigned worker
- approval requirement
- creation timestamp

PHASE 2 — BUILD ONE REAL WORKER

Create:

IVX-SENIOR-DEV-01

Capabilities required:

- clone owner GitHub repository
- inspect repository
- understand relevant code
- read logs
- reproduce defect
- diagnose root cause
- create task branch
- edit code
- add regression tests
- run typecheck
- run lint
- run unit tests
- run integration tests
- run E2E tests
- create commit
- push to owner GitHub
- create rollback tag
- trigger Render
- poll deployment
- verify runtime SHA
- run production checks
- roll back on failure
- create Proof Ledger
- report evidence to IVX Chat

PHASE 3 — DEPLOY THE WORKER INDEPENDENTLY

The worker must:

- run when the Rork browser is closed
- use a persistent task queue
- maintain heartbeat
- save checkpoints
- recover after restart
- retry 429/502/503/504/timeouts
- prevent duplicate execution
- dead-letter exhausted failures
- preserve logs and artifacts

PHASE 4 — OWNER INFRASTRUCTURE

Use only owner-controlled:

- GitHub
- Render
- Supabase
- Expo/EAS
- AWS
- storage
- DNS
- secrets

Do not require a Rork session for runtime execution.

PHASE 5 — OWNER APPROVAL

Allow autonomous:

- audits
- diagnosis
- branch creation
- code edits
- tests

Require explicit approval for:

- GitHub production merge/write
- Render production deployment
- database migrations
- destructive operations
- financial operations
- app-store publishing

PHASE 6 — LIVE WORK

Show inside IVX:

- task ID
- state
- worker
- repository
- branch
- current step
- files inspected
- files changed
- tests
- heartbeat
- retries
- commit
- deployment
- runtime SHA
- proof

PHASE 7 — FINAL CERTIFICATION TEST

Close Rork completely.

Using only IVX Chat, execute:

“Audit and fix the active 503 issue.”

The test passes only when IVX:

1. creates the task
2. diagnoses the issue
3. edits code
4. runs tests
5. requests owner approval
6. commits to owner GitHub
7. deploys to Render
8. verifies production
9. returns complete proof to IVX Chat

REQUIRED FINAL EVIDENCE

- worker service name
- worker deployment ID
- files created
- database migrations
- task ID
- branch
- files changed
- tests
- commit SHA
- Render Deployment ID
- runtime SHA
- health results
- live feature result
- rollback evidence
- Proof Ledger ID
- video showing Rork closed during execution

Do not label the system “IVX IA Senior Developer — VERIFIED” until this exact chat-only test passes.

Until then use:

IVX OWNER AI — ENGINEERING COMMAND INTERFACE
